11.t: Working with data: rainfall in Ho Chi Minh City
q: Which month shown has the most rainfall?
How much more rain falls in July than in March?
Describe the pattern of rainfall through the year.
Very dry from about December to April (about 10 to 15 mm), then a wet season from May to November, peaking around September.
Use the water cycle to explain why the wet season brings so much rain.
In the wet season, warm moist air from the sea is carried over the land; the warm air rises and cools, so its water vapour condenses into large clouds; droplets join and fall as heavy rain.
